name: Tannenhof
beschreibung: The Tannenhof is peacefully situated on the outskirts of Tyrol, surrounded by idyllic forests and lush meadows. The hotel combines traditional alpine architecture with contemporary comfort. Guests can look forward to spacious rooms, hearty home-style cuisine prepared with regional produce, and a relaxing wellness area with sauna. The picturesque surroundings are ideal for hiking tours and leisurely strolls. A dedicated family service and well-kept interior ensure a thoroughly pleasant stay.
